title: INVOL (REACC) ? VOL (Pre-Move, +ve Later) � Positive VOL Deducted from Delay
description:
System auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL), then customer voluntarily changed to an even LATER flight via Pre-Move (+ve VOL). The extra 2 hours the customer added by going later is DEDUCTED from the total delay. Validates positive VOL deduction logic after INVOL.

PNR: Single passenger (Sophie Tremblay); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-3): REACC (MUC1A06AC) ? new arrival 14:00; Change 2 (D-2): Pre-Move VOL (RF-PMV / YMQAC0848) ? customer goes LATER, new arrival 16:00 (+2hrs added); Actual arrival: 16:00; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
